admission.justification: The viewer's single realization carries the retained parsed list and editor identity; the component case guards the unchanged, changed and current-refusal facets. The cache no longer serves a working viewer result, so the two-file span no longer holds.

applicability: An open working-leaf change-set viewer while its selected before/after content remains unchanged.
conditions: The settled 2500 ms validation loop uses the shared conditional list/file resources; comparison snapshots are excluded from working polling.
Unchanged retained values preserve the mounted CodeMirror MergeView; changed content may replace it and a current refusal remains visible.
A working view is read natively on each poll (MIK-R176 rule 5's no-cache decision); the no-Git-computation guarantee is withdrawn for the working view.
exclusions: Cold loads, actual native input changes, changed selected content and failures are not zero-work/no-remount claims.
No independent timing threshold, first-visit performance grade or fresh Curator browser/Git witness.

evidence: sync-L81-dashboard.txt; sync-L81-primary-regressions.txt; body-viewer-witness12.json six304/zero-body polls over8.502s, sameCodeMirror; conditional-candidate11-settled.json zeroGit after settled warmup

statement: The open viewer retains its CodeMirror node, and an unchanged 2.5 s working poll recomputes the native change set while re-rendering only when its content changes.
